author: brossow
releaseNotes: Both drivers now share one copy of their common code, so a fix lands in both at once, and an off-hub test suite runs on every change. Setpoints no longer fail when a dashboard or Rule Machine sends the value as text, and they round to the nearest whole degree instead of dropping the fraction -- 70.5 now means 71. In Celsius, the setpoint shown is the one actually sent to the unit. Debug logs now show only the last four characters of serial numbers and account ids and never the full email address, so a log is safe to paste into the forum when asking for help. A new device starts out using the hub's own temperature scale. The driver version appears on the device page under Data. Water heater: an on-off-only heater now lists its real modes, so heat() works on it, and the supportedModes attribute has been renamed supportedWaterHeaterModes -- the driver clears the old one for you. It also no longer redeclares attributes and commands that the ThermostatMode capability already provides. The water heater driver still has not been tested on a real water heater.
